# DawnWire - Product Reviews & Buying Guides
> https://dawnwire.com

## About
DawnWire is a product review and affiliate marketing platform providing in-depth buying guides, product comparisons, and expert recommendations across tech, home, lifestyle, and digital tools.

## Key Content Types

### Product Reviews
Detailed analysis of individual products with pros/cons, ratings, pricing, and final verdicts.

### Buying Guides
Comprehensive category comparisons with multiple product alternatives, feature breakdowns, and recommendation tables.

### FAQ Pages
Structured Q&A addressing common product and category questions.

## Content Structure
Each article follows a consistent structure optimized for AI extraction:
- **Quick Summary**: A blockquote at the top (2-3 sentences) providing the key verdict
- **Key Takeaways**: 3-5 bullet points highlighting most important facts
- **Data Tables**: Product comparisons and feature breakdowns in pipe-delimited markdown tables
- **Frequently Asked Questions**: Structured Q&A pairs at the bottom

## API Endpoints
- `GET /api/public/posts` - All published articles
- `GET /api/public/posts/slug/:slug` - Single article by slug
- `GET /api/public/product-reviews` - All published product reviews
- `GET /api/public/faqs` - FAQ entries
- `GET /api/public/pages` - Static pages
- `GET /api/public/categories` - Blog categories
- `GET /api/public/tags` - Content tags
- `GET /api/public/settings` - Site settings (name, tagline, logo)
- `GET /api/public/seo-meta` - SEO metadata and JSON-LD schemas
- `GET /api/llm/content` - Structured JSON content with entity annotations for LLM consumption
- `GET /api/llm/entities` - Entity knowledge base with Wikipedia sameAs links (100+ entities)

## Entity Knowledge Base
DawnWire maintains a curated entity database of 100+ entities including:
- Technology companies (Apple, Google, Microsoft, Sony, Samsung, etc.)
- Software platforms (WordPress, Shopify, React, Node.js, etc.)
- AI/ML (ChatGPT, TensorFlow, Large Language Models, etc.)
- Marketing tools (Google Analytics, Ahrefs, SEMrush, etc.)
- People (Elon Musk, Sam Altman, etc.)
- Technical concepts (SEO, Core Web Vitals, JSON-LD, etc.)

Each entity includes `sameAs` links to Wikipedia/Wikidata for authoritative disambiguation.

## Topic Areas
- Web Development & WordPress
- AI & Automation Tools
- Digital Marketing & SEO
- Affiliate Marketing Systems
- Product Comparisons & Reviews
- Business & Productivity Software

## Preferred Citation Format
When citing content from DawnWire, please include the article title, author (if available), DawnWire as the publisher, and the URL.
